headline: THE EASYGOING SPIRIT.
personality: For someone friendly and easygoing, who puts people at ease and brings gentle humor to everyday life.
primaryText:
For someone friendly and easygoing, who puts people at ease and brings gentle humor to everyday life.

Explore Mojito Metallique and discover which fragrance feels like you. Tap Find Your Scent to explore your match.

concept: A sunny casual tabletop game pause: close overhead/waist crop of one adult Filipino woman's hands over a glossy golden-yellow outdoor cafe table. She wears cream shorts and a coral-and-cream striped cotton top, a small braided warm-orange wristband. Right hand holds the complete golden MOJITO METALLIQUE bottle by lower glass, white label square to lens. Her free left hand gently sets a burgundy wooden domino on a small red-and-cream checker-pattern cloth in the lower left. No foods or drinks, no ingredient props, no headphones, no handbag. One low red stool edge supplies a warm arc. Joyful uncomplicated afternoon energy through tactile hand gesture and color. Warm golden table fills the top32%, clean and empty. Product around x62%, y58%, cap and base intact; foreground quiet coral/cream shorts at bottom.
